title: orch factory ticket data: ext.factory
description: Owned by the factory add-on (its ticket_ext; the add-on ships a byte-identical copy). The core never reads it. A CACHE for the dashboard and the manager: every authority decision (start, stops, changes, autopilot) is derived again from the ticket's human-answered factory:* questions and the add-on journal, never from these fields (contracts/addons/factory/README.md, Authority). On an order (parent ticket) role = order; on a crew sub-ticket role = crew.

kind.description: Order only. run = a normal Factory run; autopilot = an autopilot order (the agent may decide routine/taste items itself while its grant is valid).

stage.description: Order only. draft = idea being polished; proposed = a Run proposal waits for Start; running = the crew works; waiting = a stop or change waits for the owner; shipped / cancelled = finished.

hash.description: sha256 of the frozen proposal file.

line.description: Order only. The stages of the started proposal with their state (for the stage bar).

stop.description: true = the owner decides at the end of this stage.

by.description: Who answered the stop (agent:factory only under an autopilot grant).

crew.description: Order only. Crew sub-ticket ids (their parent is this order).

active_min_used.description: Measured agent run time on this order and its crew; waiting for the owner never counts.

api_usd_target.description: A planning target, not a cap (no usage contract yet).

tiny.description: Order only. Small changes the manager did without a change proposal (cap: 3 changes or 30 min).

grant_until.description: Autopilot order only: when its grant ends (display; checked against the journal and the answer).

order.description: Crew only: the order (same as the ticket's parent).

task.description: Crew only: the proposal task slug this sub-ticket does (one sub-ticket per order + task).

crew_role.description: Crew only: builder, reviewer, writer, designer, checker …

agent.description: Crew only: the adapter or [agents.<name>] entry its runs use.
